name: FOX Colony EtherRouter meta-transaction resolver takeover
summary: The FOX Colony EtherRouter exposed executeMetaTransaction, which self-called with address(this).call and therefore passed DSAuth's src == address(this) trust check, so the attacker meta-signed setResolver to point the router at a malicious resolver deployed two blocks earlier, then called drain() through the hijacked resolver to sweep the full USDC balance and the FOX balance, swapping the FOX for WETH in the same transaction.
notes: Directly deployed EtherRouter runtime combining executeMetaTransaction self-calls with DSAuth authorization since creation. No code-mutation path touches the router runtime; the resolver pointer lives in separate storage, and the runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

Exact receipt accounting: one Transfer of 132,704.591501 USDC from the router to the attacker EOA, plus 841086.343608217839604694 FOX (0xf929de51d91c77e42f5090069e0ad7a09e513c73) from the router into the attack contract and on into the pair, swapped in-tx for 1.949506469643782660 WETH paid to the attacker EOA. The WETH leg is priced at the 2026-05-13 CoinGecko daily close. The Blockaid-reported second $50k leg has no identified transaction and is not included. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.
